 Analysis
 Atlanta United travels to face New York RB in a matchup where the simulation favors the hosts decisively. Across 6,864 games where the model leaned this strongly to one side, that side won 61% of the time. New York's attack will be central—the simulation projects them to score 2.7 goals, with a 1–2 scoreline appearing in 9% of outcomes. For Atlanta to pull off the upset, their defense would need to suppress New York's scoring while converting their limited chances; the model projects just 1.1 goals for the visiting side.
